name: bristle-90-fiddle-demo
description: OPERATOR DEMO, not a gate test (deliberately absent from suites/bristle.json): builds the S1 fiddle canvas (BR_Style sliders -> BR_Preview auto-draft + a full-quality BR_Submit/Fetch lane) and hands Rhino to the operator. Run with --test and NO --headless so the app stays open for fiddling.

checkpoints.name: fiddle-canvas-ready
checkpoints.description: Canvas built + first draft landed (save-only; the demo is interactive from here)

asserts.description: first auto-draft landed - the loop is live before the operator touches anything

requires.fix: install the Slop yak package; on a dev machine a Release net48 build ships it to the Drive folder GH loads from - check `canary doctor` output for the location actually in use
install the Bristle yak package, or on a dev machine build %CANARY_REPO_BRISTLE% Bristle.GH (net48) and register its output folder in Grasshopper Developer Settings
this test loads a Slop definition from the CANARY_REPO_BRISTLE repo; check that repo out and point %CANARY_REPO_BRISTLE% at it (see workloads/tokens.json)
